info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Capital Markets Transaction Management API
info.description: The Capital Markets Transaction Management API facilitates the execution and management of wholesale trading activities within capital markets. This API enables users to initiate transactions, track trade progress, and manage related resources effectively. It is designed for financial institutions and trading firms looking to automate their trading processes and improve operational efficiency. Typical consumers include traders, portfolio managers, and financial analysts seeking to leverage advanced trading capabilities.

post.summary: Create a new capital market entry in wholesale trading.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new entry in the capital markets segment of wholesale trading. It accepts the necessary details to generate a capital market record, ensuring all required fields are validated before submission, and responds with the result of the creation operation.
